coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 4 of 8 variable items at the conceptual level (50%): explicit-solvent all-atom tetrapeptide systems, generated-versus-reference MD comparison, backbone JSD, and sidechain JSD. Several required implementation details differ.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses 1 microsecond reference replicas rather than 100 ns simulations and a generic surrogate rather than explicitly MDGEN. Omits first-frame-conditioned 10 ns segments concatenated into 100 ns trajectories. TICA uses distance features instead of sine/cosine torsion features. Backbone histograms use 60-by-60 bins rather than 100 bins, and TICA JSD is joint over two components rather than the TICA-0 marginal. Computational runtime estimates do not assess conformational sampling speed.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected near-replicate torsion JSD values (approximately 0.1 or lower), reasonable TICA-0 agreement, and recovery of slow and fast relaxation dynamics and metastable regions.
